key_insight: HiFi-Inpaint demonstrates that reference-based inpainting guided by product exemplars can preserve fine product textures and structure in human-product images, producing high-fidelity, realistic composites without sacrificing wearer or background realism.
problem_solved: Generates human-product images that retain detailed product appearance (textures, patterns, logos) when inpainting occluded or replaced regions, addressing fidelity loss common in existing inpainting methods.
method: HiFi-Inpaint: a reference-guided inpainting framework that conditions the inpainting on a product reference image to transfer fine-grained appearance.
Feature alignment and detail-refinement modules that align reference features to the target context and explicitly reconstruct high-frequency texture (multi-scale and patch-based refinement).

Training and loss design focused on perceptual fidelity (e.g., perceptual/identity/patch losses and adversarial terms) plus data/augmentation strategies to improve robustness across poses and backgrounds.
impact: Provides practitioners a practical approach to produce realistic, detail-preserving human-product composites for advertising and e-commerce, improving downstream trust and visual quality for product visualization and virtual try-on tasks.

paper_title: HiFi-Inpaint: Towards High-Fidelity Reference-Based Inpainting for Generating Detail-Preserving Human-Product Images
paper_authors: Yichen Liu, Donghao Zhou, Jie Wang, Xin Gao, Guisheng Liu
